(#{row.batchId}, #{row.sourceRowNumber}, #{row.rowHash}, #{row.employeeId}, #{row.matchType}, #{row.employeeNameMasked}, #{row.phoneMasked}, #{row.idNumberMasked}, #{row.addressMasked}, #{row.snapshotJson}, #{row.status}, #{row.errorCodesJson}, #{row.warningCodesJson}, #{row.missingFieldsJson}, #{row.warningConfirmed}, #{row.warningReason}, #{row.routeCode}, #{row.planVersionId}, #{row.planVersionHash}, #{row.matchedLegalEntityId}, #{row.companyMatchMode}, #{row.companyMatchScore}, #{row.companySecondScore}, #{row.companyMatchPolicyVersion}, #{row.companyMasterVersion}, #{row.deptLegalEntityId}, #{row.companyDeptConflict}, #{row.companyCandidatesJson}, #{row.recommendedSealId}, #{row.sealRecommendationMode}, #{row.sealCandidatesJson}, #{row.dataRequestId}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.packageId}, #{row.historicalSupplement}, #{row.historicalReason}, #{row.noExternalContractConfirmed}, #{row.generationRequestId}, #{row.sourceEventVersion}, #{row.version}, #{row.generatedTime}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select from oa_sign_onboard_import_row where batch_id = #{batchId} order by source_row_number, row_id
mapper.update: update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set snapshot_json = #{snapshotJson}, status = #{status}, error_codes_json = #{errorCodesJson}, warning_codes_json = #{warningCodesJson}, missing_fields_json = #{missingFieldsJson}, warning_confirmed = #{warningConfirmed}, warning_reason = #{warningReason}, route_code = #{routeCode}, plan_version_id = #{planVersionId}, plan_version_hash = #{planVersionHash}, matched_legal_entity_id = #{matchedLegalEntityId}, company_match_mode = #{companyMatchMode}, company_match_score = #{companyMatchScore}, company_second_score = #{companySecondScore}, company_match_policy_version = #{companyMatchPolicyVersion}, company_master_version = #{companyMasterVersion}, dept_legal_entity_id = #{deptLegalEntityId}, company_dept_conflict = #{companyDeptConflict}, company_candidates_json = #{companyCandidatesJson}, recommended_seal_id = #{recommendedSealId}, seal_recommendation_mode = #{sealRecommendationMode}, seal_candidates_json = #{sealCandidatesJson}, historical_supplement = #{historicalSupplement}, historical_reason = #{historicalReason}, no_external_contract_confirmed = #{noExternalContractConfirmed}, address_masked = #{addressMasked}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{version} and status not in ('GENERATING', 'GENERATED', 'SENT', 'PARTIAL_SENT')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set data_request_id = #{dataRequestId}, status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and ( task_id is null or ( task_id is not null and package_id is not null and data_request_id is not null and status in ('READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED') ) ) and status not in ('GENERATING', 'GENERATED')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set data_request_id = #{dataRequestId}, task_id = #{taskId}, package_id = #{packageId}, source_event_version = coalesce(source_event_version, #{sourceEventVersion}), status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and (data_request_id is null or data_request_id = #{dataRequestId}) and task_id is null and package_id is null and (source_event_version is null or source_event_version = #{sourceEventVersion}) and #{dataRequestId} is not null and #{taskId} is not null and #{packageId} is not null and #{sourceEventVersion} is not null and #{sourceEventVersion} > 0 and status not in ('GENERATING', 'GENERATED', 'SENT', 'PARTIAL_SENT')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set no_external_contract_confirmed = coalesce(#{noExternalContractConfirmed}, no_external_contract_confirmed), historical_supplement = coalesce(#{historicalSupplement}, historical_supplement), historical_reason = case when #{historicalSupplement} = 1 then #{historicalReason} else historical_reason end, warning_confirmed = coalesce(#{warningConfirmed}, warning_confirmed), warning_reason = case when #{warningConfirmed} = 1 then #{warningReason} else warning_reason end, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and ( task_id is null or ( task_id is not null and package_id is not null and data_request_id is not null and status in ('READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED') ) ) and status not in ('GENERATING', 'GENERATED')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set status = 'GENERATING', generation_request_id = #{requestId}, source_event_version = coalesce(source_event_version, version), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and task_id is null and status in ('READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set status = 'GENERATING', generation_request_id = #{requestId}, source_event_version = coalesce(source_event_version, version), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and task_id = #{taskId} and package_id is null and status in ('READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set status = 'GENERATING', generation_request_id = #{requestId}, source_event_version = coalesce(source_event_version, version), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and task_id = #{taskId} and package_id = #{packageId} and data_request_id is not null and status in ('READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED')

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set task_id = #{taskId}, package_id = #{packageId}, status = 'GENERATED', generated_time = sysdate(), version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'GENERATING' and generation_request_id = #{generationRequestId}

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row r inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = #{taskId} and upper(trim(t.scenario)) = 'ONBOARD' and t.employee_id = r.employee_id and t.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and upper(trim(t.source_type)) = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT' and t.source_business_id = cast(r.row_id as char) and t.source_event_version = cast(r.source_event_version as char) and t.status = 'READY_TO_SEND' and t.plan_version_id = r.plan_version_id and t.package_id = #{packageId} inner join oa_sign_package p on p.package_id = t.package_id and p.task_id = t.task_id and p.employee_id = r.employee_id and p.shop_dept_id = #{shopDeptId} and p.plan_version_id = r.plan_version_id and p.status = 'draft' set r.task_id = t.task_id, r.package_id = t.package_id, r.status = 'GENERATED', r.generated_time = sysdate(), r.version = r.version + 1, r.update_time = sysdate() where r.row_id = #{rowId} and r.batch_id = #{batchId} and r.version = #{expectedVersion} and r.status = 'GENERATING' and r.generation_request_id = #{generationRequestId} and (r.task_id is null or r.task_id = #{taskId}) and r.package_id is null

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set status = #{status}, error_codes_json = #{errorCodesJson}, version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where row_id = #{rowId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and status = 'GENERATING' and generation_request_id = #{generationRequestId}
update oa_sign_onboard_import_row set status = 'SENT', version = version + 1, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and status = 'GENERATED'

update oa_sign_onboard_import_row r inner join oa_sign_onboard_data_request d on d.request_id = r.data_request_id and d.row_id = r.row_id and d.batch_id = r.batch_id and d.employee_id = r.employee_id and upper(trim(d.signing_sequence)) = 'SIGNATURE_FIRST' inner join oa_sign_task t on t.task_id = r.task_id and t.package_id = r.package_id and t.employee_id = r.employee_id and upper(trim(t.scenario)) = 'ONBOARD' and upper(trim(t.source_type)) = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT' and t.source_business_id = cast(r.row_id as char) and t.source_event_version = cast(r.source_event_version as char) inner join oa_sign_package p on p.package_id = r.package_id and p.task_id = r.task_id and p.employee_id = r.employee_id and p.shop_dept_id = t.shop_dept_id and p.plan_version_id = t.plan_version_id and upper(trim(p.signing_sequence)) = 'SIGNATURE_FIRST' set r.status = #{rowTerminalStatus}, r.version = r.version + 1, r.update_time = sysdate() where t.task_id = #{taskId} and p.package_id = #{packageId} and r.employee_id = #{employeeId} and t.status = #{terminalTaskStatus} and p.status = #{terminalPackageStatus} and d.status = 'CANCELLED' and ( (#{terminalTaskStatus} = 'REFUSED' and #{terminalPackageStatus} = 'refused' and #{rowTerminalStatus} = 'REFUSED') or (#{terminalTaskStatus} = 'EXPIRED' and #{terminalPackageStatus} = 'expired' and #{rowTerminalStatus} = 'EXPIRED') ) and r.status in ( 'WAITING_EMPLOYEE_DATA', 'PENDING_HR_REVIEW', 'PROFILE_SYNC_APPLYING', 'PROFILE_SYNC_FAILED', 'READY_TO_GENERATE', 'GENERATE_FAILED' )
mapper.select: select distinct batch_id from oa_sign_onboard_import_row where task_id = #{taskId} or (#{packageId} is not null and package_id = #{packageId}) order by batch_id

select distinct data_request_id from oa_sign_onboard_import_row where data_request_id is not null and (task_id = #{taskId} or (#{packageId} is not null and package_id = #{packageId})) order by data_request_id
